drhp.business: QMS MAS serves institutional clients in the pharmaceutical and insurance domains through healthcare camp projects, Patient Support Programs (PSPs) and screening camps, while also distributing a broad portfolio of medical and healthcare products in partnership with established healthcare brands. Its Point of Care Division serves institutional clients with devices and consumables, and its online/retail business is supported by its own consumer healthcare brand, Q Devices.
drhp.end_markets: Institutional clients (pharmaceutical and insurance domains)|Online and retail consumer channel|Public domain / state governments (potential)
drhp.expansion: QMS MAS is positioning to expand business operations on a national scale, citing growth in healthcare infrastructure funding and delivery systems. It sees potential expansion into the hospital segment for product distribution and service projects with state governments, and intends to acquire new medical technologies to supplement its revenue lines. During FY2025-26 the company managed 106 camp projects and 20 Patient Support Programs, and its services division conducted 32,380 screening camps across the country.

Diagnostics is positioned as the cornerstone of India's healthcare sector, split into in vitro diagnostics (pathology tests on samples) and in vivo diagnostics (radiology). Within IVD, molecular diagnostics analyses nucleic acids (DNA/RNA) via PCR, isothermal amplification, nucleic acid hybridisation and microarrays to detect infectious disease, oncology and genetic conditions.
